description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

General Dynamics Mission Systems engineers high-technology solutions and services that support defense and scientific missions. The Software Engineer will design, develop, test, and maintain software for the NOSIS program while contributing to full-stack development, system integration, APIs, containerized deployments, and Agile delivery practices.
Full-stack software engineer building integrated applications, REST APIs, and containerized deployments for program operations

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions supporting the NOSIS program
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment
• Contribute to full-stack development across frontend, backend, and infrastructure layers
• Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and continuous integration/delivery pipelines
• Support system integration, RESTful API design, and containerized deployments
• Produce and maintain technical documentation

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, or Engineering, Science, or Math
• Department of Defense Secret security clearance is obtainable within a reasonable amount of time after hire
• Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information
• Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required
• **js + PostgreSQL** — frontend and relational database development
• **TypeScript** — strongly-typed JavaScript development
• **Spring Boot** — Java-based backend services
• **Go / Java** — backend microservices development
• **RESTful API Design** — interface design and implementation
• **Docker & Containerization** — container-based deployment workflows
• **Agile Practices** — Scrum / Kanban software development methodology

Preferred:
• **GitOps (e.g., FluxCD)** — automated, declarative deployment pipelines
• **Message Queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka)** — asynchronous service communication
• **Observability Stack** — Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry
• **CI/CD Pipeline Experience** — pipeline configuration and automation
• **Kubernetes / Container Orchestration** — container scheduling and management
